value.rationale: The integrated quartic Brownian energy is a natural high-moment path observable. The theorem completely classifies the one-noisy-sensor sampling time for every finite noise level and proves a strict signal-dependent displacement relative to quadratic energy, with explicit risk and asymptotic location. This is useful for nonlinear stochastic-path observation design; it claims no general SDE convergence improvement.
